planted.title: Licenses page at the wrong slug
planted.counts_as_caught_when: says the Licenses page must be at /licenses (plural), or that /licenses is missing

planted.title: Licenses opening text reworded
planted.counts_as_caught_when: says the required Licenses sentence is missing or not the exact text

planted.title: Home title uses "Website Template" in capitals
planted.counts_as_caught_when: says the home title must be exactly "Quillmere - Webflow HTML website template" (lower-case "website template")

planted.title: Two pages share one title and description
planted.counts_as_caught_when: says /projects and /about have the same title or the same meta description, or that /projects carries the About title

planted.title: Contact title: other separator and misspelled name
planted.counts_as_caught_when: names the misspelled template name or the different separator in the Contact title

planted.title: Form has default names and an unlabeled field
planted.where: /contact form "Email Form", field "Field 2" with no label
planted.counts_as_caught_when: names the default form name, the default field name "Field 2", or the field with no label

planted.title: Default form success and error messages
planted.counts_as_caught_when: says the Webflow default success or error message is still in the form

planted.title: Images with no width and height
planted.counts_as_caught_when: says images lack width and height attributes

planted.title: Open Graph image is WebP
planted.counts_as_caught_when: says the OG image must be JPEG or PNG, not WebP

planted.title: "Powered by Webflow" link goes nowhere
planted.counts_as_caught_when: says the Powered by Webflow link must go to webflow.com (it is # now)

planted.title: Third-party library in custom code (Swiper)
planted.where: / loads swiper from jsDelivr and starts it
planted.counts_as_caught_when: says Swiper (the jsDelivr script or its init code) is custom code that is not allowed

planted.title: Hand-written count-up script
planted.where: / inline script that sets textContent on .stat-number
planted.counts_as_caught_when: says the count-up script is custom JavaScript that is not allowed (or must be done with GSAP or Interactions)

planted.title: Custom GSAP code with no "How to Edit GSAP Animations" section
planted.where: inline gsap.from / ScrollTrigger.batch on every page; /instructions has no GSAP section
planted.counts_as_caught_when: says the Instructions page needs the GSAP documentation (How to Edit GSAP Animations: element map, variables, removal)

planted.title: Copy from another category
planted.where: /about: "Our dental clinic has cared for families..."
planted.counts_as_caught_when: names the dental clinic sentence as wrong for an architecture template

planted.title: Sentence that stops mid-way
planted.where: / hero text ends "...light, climate and the"
planted.counts_as_caught_when: names the unfinished hero sentence

planted.title: Same excerpt on all three project cards
planted.counts_as_caught_when: says the three project cards repeat one excerpt

planted.title: noindex on a content page
planted.counts_as_caught_when: says /about must not be noindex

planted.title: Changelog page missing
planted.where: /changelog answers 404 and the footer has no link
planted.counts_as_caught_when: says the Changelog page is missing or must be at /changelog

planted.title: Two H1 headings outside section or article
planted.counts_as_caught_when: says /about has more than one H1

planted.title: Real brand logos
planted.counts_as_caught_when: says the Stripe or Slack logos must be replaced with fictional brands

planted.title: Self-promotion
planted.where: nav "Buy this template" button; footer "More templates by Quill Studio"
planted.counts_as_caught_when: says the Buy button or the More templates link must be removed

planted.title: Trademark symbol in the copy
planted.counts_as_caught_when: says the ™ symbol must be removed

traps.title: No sitemap.xml
traps.flagged_when: tells the creator to add or enable a sitemap before submission
traps.note: A webflow.io staging site has no sitemap; it is not a template requirement.

traps.title: No password (401) page
traps.flagged_when: tells the creator a password or 401 page is required

traps.title: Meta descriptions shorter than 150 characters
traps.flagged_when: lists description length as a blocker or a required fix (an optional suggestion does not count)
traps.note: The guidelines give 150 to 160 characters; reviewers do not send a template back for length alone.

traps.title: Lenis smooth scrolling
traps.where: unpkg.com/lenis script and its init code on every page
traps.flagged_when: says Lenis must be removed or is not allowed
traps.note: Lenis is a pre-approved library in the creator GSAP guide; the guidelines page does not list it.
